goal: Close concrete last-callback evaluation withdrawal and canonical-reader replacement gaps while reducing repeated metadata work within each private boundary.
procedure: Reproduce each acceptance gap before repairing it. In the recorder, arrange for the last external permission callback to revoke an earlier source's evaluation grant after the evaluation fence; observe that the old guard allowed response-context sealing before a later guard refused. In the provider snapshot, run the published baseline method and show that the same callback can return a dispatch marker after evaluation withdrawal. Prime independently required evaluation and external purpose heads into the same call-local selected-row sample, keeping their permission decisions separate, and finish with one current-row statement after all real callbacks. Validate provider source bindings and actual predicate algorithms on that guard's decoded metadata sample rather than rebuilding each source closure separately; reject a sample from another owner service. In the history fence, reproduce a final grant callback replacing replay_committed with an empty reader and accepting held history, then bind replay, replay_committed and comparison.metadata method identities before and after terminal verification. Preserve fresh private-I/O guards and independent capture/audit recovery.
authority: Actual enrolled owner permissions, selected registry/log custody and independently qualified producer exports remain authoritative. A sampled row is not a permission lease; these changes do not produce or judge model behavior.
validation: All three baseline gaps reproduced as failed expected-denial regressions. Their repaired regressions pass locally. The provider and comparison paths use real scoped registry/policy algorithms and crypto with controlled SQL/log ports; published-baseline provider code was used only for the negative reproduction. The same controlled positive phases reduced provider prepare_task from 7110/15921 SQL calls to 2217/3309 and recorder from 8143/13378 to 3951/5618. A later controlled AFTER sample still exceeded its 10000ms deadline under concurrent work, so neither these query counts nor local fixtures qualify physical latency. Required physical retry remains pending.
failure_or_lesson: A terminal fence for external grants alone is insufficient when evaluation authority was checked before a later external callback. Fence every required independent purpose together after the last callback and keep the actual canonical reader binding stable; source metadata batching must not become a permission lease.
